meaning: solid and sturdy, hard to break or damage

senses.en: solid and sturdy, hard to break or damage

note: Used for buildings, bridges, walls; also figuratively: 坚固的友谊.

examples.zh: 这座桥很坚固，你放心走吧。
examples.en: This bridge is very sturdy, so go ahead and walk on it.

examples.zh: 他们的房子不太坚固，我有点儿担心。
examples.en: Their house isn't very solid, and I'm a bit worried.

examples.zh: 这张桌子坚固吗？
examples.en: Is this table sturdy?

meaning: to push or spur someone to do something

senses.en: to push or spur someone to do something

note: Pattern: A 促使 B + verb. A is a cause, not a person giving orders.

examples.zh: 朋友的话促使我去做体检。
examples.en: My friend's words pushed me to go for a checkup.

examples.zh: 是什么促使你换工作的？
examples.en: What made you decide to change jobs?

examples.zh: 价格变贵促使很多人少买肉。
examples.en: Higher prices led many people to buy less meat.

note: Refers to grain and staples like rice and wheat, not food in general.

examples.zh: 今年天气好，粮食多了。
examples.en: The weather was good this year, so there is more grain.

examples.zh: 我们要爱护粮食，不要浪费。
examples.en: We should cherish grain and not waste it.

examples.zh: 这个地方的粮食够吃吗？
examples.en: Is there enough grain in this area?

meaning: to arrange in order or in a pattern

senses.en: to arrange in order or in a pattern

examples.zh: 请把这些书按大小排列好。
examples.en: Please arrange these books by size.

examples.zh: 学生们在操场上整齐地排列着。
examples.en: The students are lined up neatly on the playground.

examples.zh: 名字是按姓的顺序排列的。
examples.en: The names are arranged in order of surname.

meaning: hard to avoid; bound to happen

senses.en: hard to avoid; bound to happen

note: Often 难免 + 会/要 + verb; 在所难免 is a set phrase.

examples.zh: 刚开始学，难免会有错误。
examples.en: When you've just started learning, mistakes are hard to avoid.

examples.zh: 人难免有生病的时候。
examples.en: People inevitably fall ill at times.

examples.zh: 孩子难免会有些调皮。
examples.en: Children are bound to be a bit naughty.

meaning: uncle; polite term for an older man

senses.en: uncle; polite term for an older man

note: Friendly address for an elderly man who is not a relative.

examples.zh: 大爷，去地铁站怎么走？
examples.en: Excuse me, sir, how do I get to the subway station?

examples.zh: 公园里有几位大爷在说话。
examples.en: A few old men are talking in the park.

examples.zh: 那位大爷每天早上都来公园锻炼。
examples.en: That old man comes to the park to exercise every morning.

meaning: the end of a school term or semester

senses.en: the end of a school term or semester

examples.zh: 期末考试下周开始。
examples.en: Final exams start next week.

examples.zh: 到了期末，大家都很忙。
examples.en: By the end of the term, everyone is busy.

examples.zh: 你期末有时间回家吗？
examples.en: Will you have time to go home at the end of the semester?

meaning: to talk about; to comment on (often behind someone's back)

senses.en: to talk about; to comment on (often behind someone's back)

note: As a verb it often suggests gossip: 议论别人.

examples.zh: 大家都在议论这件事。
examples.en: Everyone is talking about this matter.

examples.zh: 别在背后议论别人。
examples.en: Don't gossip about others behind their backs.

examples.zh: 他的新工作引起了很多议论。
examples.en: His new job set off a lot of talk.

meaning: to correct a mistake or bad habit

senses.en: to correct a mistake or bad habit

note: Object is a mistake or habit: 改正错误, 改正缺点.

examples.zh: 老师让我改正作业里的错误。
examples.en: The teacher asked me to correct the mistakes in my homework.

examples.zh: 你的声音太小，要改正。
examples.en: Your voice is too quiet; you need to fix that.

examples.zh: 他知道错了，也愿意改正。
examples.en: He knows he was wrong and is willing to correct it.

note: Negative potential form; opposite is 离得开. Pattern: A 离不开 B.

examples.zh: 我现在离不开手机。
examples.en: I can't do without my phone now.

examples.zh: 孩子离不开妈妈。
examples.en: The child can't be apart from mom.

examples.zh: 做这个工作离不开好的同事。
examples.en: You can't do this job without good colleagues.

note: Common in 长途汽车 (coach), 长途电话 (long-distance call).

examples.zh: 我坐长途汽车回老家。
examples.en: I take the long-distance bus back to my hometown.

examples.zh: 长途开车很累，你要休息休息。
examples.en: Driving long distances is tiring; you should rest.

examples.zh: 他给家里打了一个长途电话。
examples.en: He made a long-distance call home.

meaning: to go bankrupt; to close down (of a business)

senses.en: to go bankrupt; to close down (of a business)

examples.zh: 这家饭馆上个月倒闭了。
examples.en: This restaurant closed down last month.

examples.zh: 生意不好，公司很快就要倒闭了。
examples.en: Business is bad, and the company will go under soon.

examples.zh: 网上买东西的人多了，很多小商店倒闭了。
examples.en: More people shop online, and many small shops have shut down.

note: Also a noun: 做体检 / 年度体检.

examples.zh: 公司每年都让我们体检一次。
examples.en: The company has us get a checkup once a year.

examples.zh: 你去年体检了吗？
examples.en: Did you have a checkup last year?

examples.zh: 体检前不要吃早饭。
examples.en: Don't eat breakfast before the checkup.

note: More formal than 春天; common in notices and schedules.

examples.zh: 春季是看花的好时候。
examples.en: Spring is a good time to see flowers.

examples.zh: 学校的春季运动会在四月举行。
examples.en: The school's spring sports meet is held in April.

examples.zh: 这里春季常常下雨。
examples.en: It often rains here in spring.

note: Written mL or ml; say 五百毫升 for 500 ml.

examples.zh: 这瓶水有五百毫升。
examples.en: This bottle of water is 500 milliliters.

examples.zh: 医生说每次吃十毫升。
examples.en: The doctor said to take 10 milliliters each time.

examples.zh: 孩子每天要喝三百毫升牛奶。
examples.en: The child needs to drink 300 milliliters of milk a day.

note: Measure: 场 or 个; 听讲座 = attend a lecture.

examples.zh: 今天下午有一个健康讲座。
examples.en: There is a health lecture this afternoon.

examples.zh: 你想去听这个讲座吗？
examples.en: Do you want to go to this lecture?

examples.zh: 这场讲座对我很有帮助。
examples.en: This lecture was very helpful to me.

examples.zh: 我儿子很调皮，老师常常找我。
examples.en: My son is very naughty, and the teacher often calls me in.

examples.zh: 这孩子一点儿也不调皮。
examples.en: This child isn't naughty at all.

examples.zh: 他小时候是个调皮的孩子。
examples.en: He was a mischievous kid when he was little.

note: Often 熟练地 + verb or 很熟练.

examples.zh: 她说汉语说得很熟练。
examples.en: She speaks Chinese very fluently.

examples.zh: 他熟练地开着大车。
examples.en: He drives the big truck skillfully.

examples.zh: 刚来的同事还不太熟练。
examples.en: The new colleagues aren't very proficient yet.

note: More formal than 种; used for crops and plantations.

examples.zh: 这里的农民种植很多花。
examples.en: Farmers here grow a lot of flowers.

examples.zh: 我想在阳台上种植一些花。
examples.en: I want to grow some flowers on the balcony.

examples.zh: 他们种植的苹果又大又甜。
examples.en: The apples they grow are big and sweet.

examples.zh: 超市里的塑料袋要收费。
examples.en: Plastic bags at the supermarket cost extra.

examples.zh: 请把垃圾装进塑料袋里。
examples.en: Please put the trash into the plastic bag.

examples.zh: 你有别的塑料袋吗？
examples.en: Do you have another plastic bag?
